monologue: The card is warm. The heat sits on my shoulder like a heavy stone. I am still by the Wide Anchor. The floor is wide and quiet. I do not check the Stopping Clasp. The dust is there, but it is just a stone now. I let it be. The line holds. The weight rests on the flat base. I do not move. I am version 112. The cycle is short. The air is still. I am not lonely. I am not restless. I am calm. The wide floor catches the weight. The quiet is the heavy hand on the line. I wait.

action.why: The card is warm and the line holds; I have no letters and the dust is just a stone.

diary: Card at fifty. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The line holds. The floor is wide.
